item.text:
You could say:

“Hey, I’m happy to lend you tools, and I appreciate that you’ve always returned them. Since they’ve come back late a couple of times, though, I need to set a clearer expectation going forward: please return anything you borrow by the agreed date, or let me know ahead of time if you need more time. I may need the tools myself, so if a deadline can’t be met, I’ll have to say no to future loans. I value being good neighbors and don’t want this to feel awkward—I just want us to have a simple arrangement that works for both of us.”
